description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-087 Web Designing against its five linked web-focused records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's six governed module headings; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. Headings 3 and 6 are cited by their governed text with the verified display corrections. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

web_forms_email: building web forms (such as contact forms)
web_design_ux: designing website layouts or user interfaces
web_databases: designing or using databases for web applications
web_cms: using or deploying a website content management system
web_security: securing websites or web applications (including security testing or configuration)
web_requirements_methodology: gathering requirements or applying a software development methodology

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (units, modules, learning outcomes or verified scope passages as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: Only web-focused records are linked; DGT COPA, the Sri Lankan ICT Technician standard and ITE IT Systems & Networks were not reused because their web content is incidental to general ICT or networking programmes.
India's record cites the qualification's verified description and level descriptors because its module titles are broad.
Australia's record is limited to the core and the Group G units the Web Development specialisation requires.
ITE's Web Content Management module is cited by its title for content management systems and by its objective for publishing and testing.
